title: JobPosting
description: Final unified Saudi job posting record after merging, cleaning, verifying the 2026 publication date, classifying specialization, and extracting normalized technical skills.

source_job_id.description: Original job identifier provided by JSearch or Headcount Labs. null if unavailable. IDs may differ across APIs for the same job.

job_title.description: Title exactly as written in the original job posting.

company.description: Company name as provided by the source API.

location.description: City as given in the posting, e.g. Riyadh. null if missing.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. SA. null if unavailable.

specialization.description: Primary technical specialization assigned during the classification phase. Jobs outside the nine target domains are excluded from the final analyzed dataset.

technical_skills.description: Technical skills, tools, technologies, and frameworks explicitly stated in the posting's requirements or preferred qualifications. Extract after merging, using a shared canonical skill vocabulary. Normalize synonyms and spellings (e.g., PowerBI -> Power BI), preserve official casing/punctuation (e.g., C++, C#, .NET), and exclude soft skills. Use [] when extraction was completed but no technical skills were found. JSON Schema alone cannot validate equivalence of skill synonyms.

items.description: Canonical technical skill/tool label, without leading or trailing whitespace.

description.description: Full original job posting text. Preserved for future skill re-extraction and validation.

source.description: API used to collect the job posting.

publisher.description: Original publishing platform or applicant tracking system, e.g. LinkedIn, Workday, Greenhouse, or Lever. null if unknown.

posted_date.description: Verified original publication date, YYYY-MM-DD, within calendar year 2026. Unknown or unverified dates must be excluded from this final dataset, but may be retained in raw/collection data. Validate date format with a JSON Schema FormatChecker.
